BEFORE THE NEW MEXICO PUBLIC REGULATION COMMISSION

 IN THE MATTER OF THE APPLICATION OF                       )
 EL PASO ELECTRIC COMPANY FOR                              )
 REVISION OF ITS RETAIL ELECTRIC RATES                     )   Docket No. 25-00082-UT
 PURSUANT TO ADVICE NOTICE NO. 317                         )


                       ORDER CLARIFYING SUA SPONTE ORDER

       THIS MATTER comes before the Hearing Examiners upon the Utility Division Staff's

Motion to Clarify Sua Sponte Order ("Motion"), filed August 3, 2026. Having reviewed the

Motion, being otherwise fully advised, and finding good cause, the Hearing Examiners issue the

following clarifications:

       1.        Staff requests clarification of decretal paragraph H of the Sua Sponte Order,

noting that the second sentence appears to omit the word "not," resulting in an apparent

inconsistency within the paragraph. The omission was inadvertent. Accordingly, the second

sentence of decretal paragraph H shall read:

            a. "Staff shall not provide any advice or commentary on whether EPE's substantive

               requests are reasonable, lawful, or supported by the weight of the evidence."

       2.        Staff also requests clarification regarding decretal paragraph G(9), which directs

Staff to consider whether EPE has adequately supplemented affected discovery responses. Staff

explains that, given the volume of discovery in this proceeding and the limited seven-day review

period, comprehensive review of discovery responses is not practicable.

            a. Upon further consideration, the Hearing Examiners conclude that decretal

               paragraph G(9) is unnecessary. Questions concerning the adequacy of discovery

               responses are matters appropriately addressed by the parties through the normal
             BEFORE THE NEW MEXICO PUBLIC REGULATION COMMISSION
Order Clarifying Sua Sponte Order                     Docket No. 25-00082-UT


               discovery process and, if necessary, by motion practice. Accordingly, decretal

               paragraph G(9) is stricken and shall have no further force or effect.

       3.        Except as expressly clarified and modified herein, the Sua Sponte Order Vacating

Procedural Schedule, Tolling Pending Deadlines, and Requiring the Filing of an Amended

Application remains in full force and effect.


   ISSUED under the seal of the Commission at Santa Fe, New Mexico, on August 4, 2026.

                       NEW MEXICO PUBLIC REGULATION COMMISSION




                       Nicholas Rossi
                       Hearing Examiner
                       Nicholas.Rossi@prc.nm.gov
